family: One fixed total language evaluated by family.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. N<128 outputs0; larger N uses L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L), actual L-bit header encoding S-1. Every1<=S<=2^L is evaluated, failed scalar plans output0. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z^2),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^3),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^5),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^5),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^7),k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^9). Initial A1 dimension11, precision E0=ceil(L/16)+10, checked seed d0<=8L. Its122 field-element data and the B5 modulus follow the header; all these actual bits count in prefix P. Other five internal maps have zero data and deterministic tower fields. Four B2.2 maps use t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t,T=ceil(2a^2/t)+a,hash blocks B=E+ceil(log2 M)+10,source threshold4rho*M and K>=32B; seed O(E^2/z) at fixed scale. Short E1 is B2.3 direct multi-bit hash with seed O(eprime). The index alphabet2 and d0 rounds are separate from independence h. Robust layout uses delta=1/125,m=floor(r/125),w=ceil(log2 r),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^2/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. B5 uses degree1000w fields,100w-bit blocks and its separate3/2 CE design in T=ceil(5a^2/2)+a for a=2000w; only its hash modulus is input data. All CE designs are computed, not advice. Initial bad fraction2*N^(-1/16), eventual d0<(15/2)L,P<34L and S_groups^delta<=2^(.06L) pay the robust bad-coordinate bound. Good fixed S0 is used only for a charged hardness restriction; the same total polynomial-time program handles every header/data string. Initial A1 uses the exact rational-exponent field budget in seeded_params and the supplied A1 power condition; its prediction parameter is distinct from the internal overlap weight rho.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^9. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(9+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=34L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.
